recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated urban portrait featuring a young man in denim against a white-painted brick wall, characterized by a large, soft-edged silhouette shadow cast to his side and bold, horizontally-aligned typography across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Text overlaying both subject and background
Rough brick texture versus smooth skin and fabric tones
Monochromatic palette with deep red accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned slightly left of center, shown from the waist up, occupying approximately 40% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold white primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the large white text, then right to the shadow and secondary red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame is dominated by the brick wall and the cast shadow, providing breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light grey and white (brick wall and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and slate (denim jacket and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Oxblood red (secondary text and graphic mark)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high tonal contrast between the white wall and dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to greyscale and one deep accent color

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for primary text
Stencil-like horizontal gaps in secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Secondary text features thin horizontal slices through the middle of each glyph to create a stencil effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale and color contrast between a solid bold sans and a smaller, tracked-out stencil sans.

preserve: Horizontal stencil cuts in secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean structure of the primary display text.
Provides the necessary geometric foundation for the uppercase display.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a young man with styled hair wearing a grey denim jacket over a black shirt, standing against a white-painted brick wall. A large, soft, blurry shadow of a person is cast onto the wall to his right. The image is desaturated with a cool, moody tone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold uppercase white geometric sans-serif text across the center. Below it, add smaller red stencil-style text with wide tracking, aligned to the right edge of the primary text. Include a small circular distressed red logo to the far left.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text solid white and bold?
Does the secondary text have horizontal stencil cuts?
Is the shadow soft-edged and larger than the subject?
Is the overall color palette desaturated except for the red accents?

adjustableVariables: Accent color hue (e.g., changing red to blue)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible over the subject's jacket
Check that the shadow doesn't obscure the secondary text too much
Verify the stencil cuts are clean and horizontal
Confirm the brick texture is visible through the white paint
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Brick Wall + Soft Silhouette Shadow + Overlaid Geometric Typography + Stencil Accents
